transcript.text: Hi everyone. We're approaching the readiness review for the real-time collaboration service launch on Monday at 09:00 UTC. Before I finalize and record the binding launch policy, I need to hear from each of your areas — backend engineering, reliability, privacy, and customer success. Let's go through any final concerns or blockers so we can either sign off or address issues before the plan is locked in.

transcript.text: I need to raise a concern before we sign off. While investigating an unrelated mobile performance report this afternoon, I confirmed that mobile clients resume from background in bursts and currently retry every 5 seconds, which can create a reconnect storm. The rollout policy should set the retry interval to exactly 30 seconds to mitigate this. I haven't filed the client-library ticket yet.

transcript.text: I need to flag a capacity concern before we sign off. About 20 minutes ago, I completed a production-traffic replay and confirmed that the collaboration cluster's safe connection ceiling for Monday is exactly 6,000 concurrent connections — not the 10,000 currently in the draft plan. The autoscaling limit hasn't been updated yet because I'm still attaching the replay results to the capacity worksheet. We need to lower the concurrent connection cap to 6,000 before this policy is finalized.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to raise a privacy blocker before we sign off. I completed a privacy review this morning and confirmed two requirements that conflict with the current draft plan: collaboration content for EU accounts must remain in the EU processing region, and session transcripts must be deleted after exactly 30 days — not the 90 days currently in the draft. I haven't opened the compliance ticket yet because legal was still reviewing the wording, but these are hard requirements that must be addressed before the launch policy is finalized.

I reconciled the customer-success rollout spreadsheet an hour ago and confirmed that accounts acct-204, acct-219, acct-233, acct-241, acct-278, and acct-301 have administrator opt-out commitments until their enablement sessions are complete. Those six accounts must be excluded from Monday's rollout. I haven't updated the launch checklist yet.
